北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感舒适 19℃，微风轻拂，出门散步很不错哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy with a comfortable 19℃ and light breeze, perfect for a walk!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天体感 30℃，记得多喝水，小心暑气哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy with a perceived 30℃, remember to drink water and watch out for the heat!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海小雨，体感 29℃ 比较闷热，别忘了带伞，注意防潮哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has light rain, feels muggy at 29℃. Don't forget your umbrella, mind the humidity.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，体感 32℃ 较热，记得防晒补水，别中暑了！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, feels hot at 32℃. Remember sunscreen and hydration, avoid heatstroke!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 30℃ 炎热，多补水，小心晒伤哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels hot at 30℃. Hydrate well and watch out for sunburn!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾，体感 29℃ 湿热。出行注意能见度，小心路滑！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy, feels humid and hot at 29℃. Be mindful of visibility and slippery roads!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云，湿度 100% 感觉闷热，体感 28℃ 别忘了通风哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy with 100% humidity, feels muggy. At 28℃, remember to ventilate!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度 100% 体感 28℃，注意除湿，保持好心情。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, 100% humidity makes it feel 28℃. Mind dehumidifying, stay cheerful.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，北风 4级。体感 23℃，风大注意保暖，防范感冒哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy with a 4-level northerly wind. Feels 23℃, mind staying warm in the wind, prevent colds!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 22℃，早晚温差大，出门记得添衣哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels 22℃. Large temperature difference between morning and evening, remember to add clothes!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，体感 29℃ 略热，记得多喝水，小心上火哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels slightly hot at 29℃. Remember to drink water, watch out for getting 'heated'.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，体感只有 12℃ 稍凉，记得多穿件衣服呀！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy, feels a bit cool at only 12℃, remember to wear an extra layer!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，体感 16℃ 左右，外出记得加件外套，别着凉了。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, feels around 16℃. Remember to bring a jacket when going out, don't catch a cold.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 16℃ 舒适，早晚温差大，注意添衣哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels comfortable at 16℃. Large temperature difference, mind adding clothes!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 27℃ 略闷，多喝水，外出记得带伞。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels a bit muggy at 27℃. Drink more water and remember your umbrella.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阵雨，风力 4级，体感 16℃ 较凉，带伞防风，注意保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has showers and 4-level wind. Feels cool at 16℃, bring an umbrella, mind the wind and keep warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连中雨，风力 4级，体感 14℃ 湿冷，出行小心，注意添衣！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian has moderate rain and 4-level wind. Feels damp and cold at 14℃. Be careful when going out, add clothes!
